evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28766 ppm to about 5 ppm, and it has stayed at 4-7 ppm since
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint within about 1 °C; brief 10 °C overshoot at the start of growth, settled at 750 °C
Heater power holds steady at about 44% during the growth hold, with no sign of drift
Ar flow matches the 100 sccm setpoint within 1 sccm

args.missing_evidence: There are no normal-run reference values to compare against, and no pressure gauge is installed, so exhaust blockage or a seal leak can only be ruled out indirectly from the O2 reading. No sample characterization exists yet.
